name: cavemio-inline-edit
title: Inline edit
description: Rename a title, a project or a row where it stands: the text becomes the field without moving a pixel, and saves itself.

cavemio.usage:
import { InlineEdit } from "@/components/inline-edit";

renameProject(name)} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- The field is a real textarea labelled by label, so screen readers, spellcheck, undo and the clipboard behave as anywhere else. Errors and the character count are linked with aria-describedby and marked aria-invalid; saves and refusals are announced in a status region outside the field.
- Text and field use the same letters in the same box with kerning and ligatures off, so focusing never moves a glyph. Line breaks pasted into a title become spaces.
- A refusal that arrives while you are already typing something newer keeps your new text and only shows the reason. Results from an older save are ignored.
- Type is inherited: set font size, weight and tracking on the component or its parent. On touch screens, text under 16px makes iOS zoom in when it is focused; set a 16px minimum on phones if that matters for your layout.
- Reduced motion changes everything in place: no morphs, shakes or easing; the colours and words still say what happened.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Accessible name of the field, e.g. "Project name".

props.name: value
props.description: – · The saved text, controlled. A new value morphs in when you are not editing.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Called with the stored text after a successful save.

props.name: onSave
props.description: – · Saves the new text. Return what was stored (it morphs in if different); throw an Error to refuse with its message.

props.name: validate
props.description: – · Refuses a value before it is sent; the message opens under the field.

props.name: normalize
props.description: collapse spaces, trim · Applied before validating and saving.

props.name: wrap
props.description: false · Fill the width and wrap onto more lines (titles). Off, it is one line that sizes to its text and truncates with an ellipsis at rest.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: – · Stops typing at this length and counts the last ten characters.

props.name: blurAction
props.description: "save" · What leaving the field does with an edit.

props.name: allowEmpty
props.description: false · Saves an empty value instead of going back to the saved one.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "Untitled" · Shown while the text is empty.

props.name: name
props.description: – · Submits the saved value with a form.

useCases.title: Page titles
useCases.description: Rename a project, a doc or an issue from its header, the way Linear and Notion do.

useCases.title: Table cells
useCases.description: Fix a name or a label inside a data table row without opening a form.

useCases.title: Sidebars and breadcrumbs
useCases.description: Rename a workspace, a folder or a saved view right where it’s listed.

useCases.title: Settings
useCases.description: Change a slug, a display name or an API key’s label in place, with the server’s rules applied.

features.title: The text never moves
features.description: A real field already sits under the text, letter for letter, so focusing it shifts nothing, in whatever font and size you set.

features.title: The caret lands where you click
features.description: Clicks, double-clicks and drags select exactly as in any field; Tab or F2 selects it all.

features.title: Saves the way people expect
features.description: Enter or leaving the field saves, Escape cancels and morphs back, and unchanged or emptied text never reaches your server.

features.title: Your server has the last word
features.description: Return what you stored and the text morphs into it, so a trimmed name or a generated slug shows up exactly.

features.title: Failures keep the edit
features.description: If your save throws, the field reopens with what was typed, gives a small shake and says why underneath.

features.title: Live renames don’t fight you
features.description: A new value from a teammate morphs in, but never while someone is in the middle of an edit.

states.title: rest
states.description: Plain text in your own type. Under a mouse, a 1px frame sized by the text fades in over 160ms; it extends 0.4em either side, with negative margins, so the text stays aligned with what is around it.

states.title: edit
states.description: A click focuses the field at the point you clicked (double-click selects a word); Tab, Enter or F2 select everything. The frame turns to the focus colour in 200ms. The field grows with the text: one-line fields widen, wrapped titles take more lines.

states.title: save
states.description: Enter or leaving the field calls onSave with the trimmed value. The new text stays where it is; a 14px slot opens beside one-line text (380ms) with a spinner, then a check draws itself (420ms) and the slot closes 1.4s later. Wrapped titles say Saving, then Saved, in the line below.

states.title: stored
states.description: If onSave returns a different string, the text morphs into it: shared letters glide, new ones rise out of a blur, and one-line text eases to its new width.

states.title: refused
states.description: If validate returns a message or onSave throws, the field opens again with what you typed, shakes ±4px over 380ms, its frame turns red and the reason folds open under it. Typing clears the red.

states.title: cancel
states.description: Escape morphs the text back to the saved value and keeps focus on the field; Enter edits it again. An emptied name cancels the same way unless allowEmpty is set.

states.title: elsewhere
states.description: A new value prop while you are not editing morphs in (wrapped titles crossfade whole and ease to their new height in 420ms). While you are editing, your text is left alone and Escape goes back to the newer name.

states.title: limit
states.description: With maxLength, the last ten characters are counted under the field; the number rolls down as you type.
